clips.title: The story
paras: In southwestern Duskwood, Addle's Stead lies abandoned south of Raven Hill. Its first homesteaders fled long ago, and the Defias Brotherhood now uses the farm as a hidden staging ground.

Addle's Stead fell into ruin when darkness overtook Duskwood. The Defias Brotherhood now uses the old farm. Its agents watch the perimeter and lurk in the farmhouse, while supplies fill the barn. Southwestern Duskwood's shadows help them evade the Night Watch and Stormwind authorities.
